convex-schema-sizing-modes.description: Add missing sizing mode fields (widthMode, widthPercent, heightSizingMode, heightSizingPercent, flexBasis, gridColumn, gridRow) to Convex templateElementValidator in both schema.ts and templates.ts to match the Zod schemas and frontend save handler. Currently, saving templates with sizing mode changes fails with ArgumentValidationError.
stepsToVerify: Open the Style Editor with an existing template
Select any element (e.g., Work Hours Table)
Modify the element's sizing mode via the Properties Panel (change width or height sizing)
Click Save in the Style Editor header
Verify no console errors appear (specifically no ArgumentValidationError)
Refresh the page and confirm the template loads with the saved changes
Create a new element, adjust its sizing settings, and save again to verify new elements work too

template-sizing-modes-not-loading-from-c.description: Sizing mode fields (heightMode, heightPercent, widthMode, widthPercent, heightSizingMode, heightSizingPercent) are not persisting after page reload. Root cause: the setCurrentTemplateFromConvex function in template-store.ts (lines 1048-1085) is missing these fields when mapping elements from Convex back to client state. The save function (StyleEditorHeader.tsx:284-290) correctly includes all fields, but they are lost during load.

fix.location: setCurrentTemplateFromConvex function, after layoutConfig mapping (around line 1084)

stepsToVerify: Open the Style Editor with an existing template
Select a layout container element
Change its height mode to 'auto' via the Properties Panel
Click Save in the Style Editor header
Refresh the page
Verify the height mode is still set to 'auto'
Test with other sizing modes (widthMode, heightSizingMode) to ensure all persist

properties-panel-scroll-not-working.description: The Properties panel on the right side of the Style Editor does not scroll vertically when content overflows. Both 'Properties' and 'History' tabs are affected. Root cause: TabsContent components at lines 198 and 1295 in PropertiesPanel.tsx have 'overflow-hidden' which clips the ScrollArea's custom scrollbar.
notes: The Properties/History tabs use TabsContent + ScrollArea inside a flex column. Without min-h-0 on the flex chain (TabsContent/parent), the scrollable viewport cannot shrink, so scrollbars never appear.
Both tabs share the same structure, so any fix to the scroll container should apply to both.

changes: Line 198: Remove 'overflow-hidden' from TabsContent className (Properties tab)
Line 1295: Remove 'overflow-hidden' from TabsContent className (History tab)

stepsToVerify: Open the Style Editor and select any element to open the Properties panel
Add enough content or resize browser window so Properties tab content exceeds panel height
Verify a vertical scrollbar appears and scrolling works in the Properties tab
Switch to the History tab
Verify the History tab also scrolls when content overflows
Confirm scrolling works with mouse wheel, trackpad, and dragging the scrollbar

invoice-preview-not-reflecting-style-edi.description: Invoice Preview in InvoiceCalendarPage does not reflect recent Style Editor changes. Root cause: The userTemplates useMemo conversion (lines 153-244) is missing element fields (flexBasis, gridColumn, gridRow, heightMode, heightPercent, widthMode, widthPercent, heightSizingMode, heightSizingPercent) and layoutConfig.displayMode when mapping Convex templates to InvoiceTemplate format. The template-store.ts setCurrentTemplateFromConvex is also missing layoutConfig.displayMode.
notes: Invoice preview regeneration in InvoicePreview is keyed by template.id only; template edits do not change that value, so PDF blobs can stay stale.
Consider including template.updatedAt (or a template fingerprint) in the preview key/dependencies to force regeneration after edits.
stepsToVerify: Open the Style Editor and load an existing template
Make visible changes: modify element colors, positions, or sizing modes
Click Save in the Style Editor header and wait for success toast
Navigate to the Invoice Calendar page
Select the edited template from the style picker dropdown
Verify the Invoice Preview immediately shows all saved changes
Test with sizing mode changes (width/height modes) to ensure they render correctly
Test with layout container displayMode changes (flex vs grid) if applicable
